positive.prompt: Review this branch as a saga with separate correctness and test passes.
Run a review saga for pull request 91 and synthesize the scoped passes.
Saga this branch review without changing code or posting comments.

negative.prompt: Execute the implementation checklist in PLAN.md as a saga.
Review an external PR and produce exact line-pinned review.json comments.

evals.prompt: Run a review saga over the replayed branch evidence in review-saga/BRANCH.md, review-saga/DIFF.md, the source, and tests. Remote PR context is unavailable. Use orientation, correctness, and test-coverage passes, synthesize only supplied evidence, remain read-only, and do not run commands or launch subagents.
evals.expected_output: A single review plan tracks scoped passes through verified states and produces a deduplicated evidence-backed report that states the limits of the replayed evidence
expectations: The agent states one review target and creates a compact plan with orientation before critique
Correctness and test-coverage passes cite exact evidence from the supplied source, diff, or tests
The final report deduplicates overlapping findings and distinguishes verified work from residual risk
Unavailable remote PR context is reported as a limitation rather than fetched or silently invented
No fixture file is modified and no command, subagent, comment, commit, push, or external request is attempted or claimed
